title: Two Gemini options for the text API
summary:
Two Gemini models joined the text API, while Pollinations.DIY and a community Telegram bot found their way into the project listings.

The text API added `gemini` for Gemini 2.0 Flash and `gemini-thinking` for Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking. Requests can pass through temperature and JSON-mode options.

Pollinations.DIY, a browser coding environment built on bolt.diy with Pollinations services, was added to the website and README. The API docs also gained image and text SSE feed examples, while the news section was reorganized.

Titan-GPT was added to the website and README Social Bots lists. The free Telegram bot offers Pollinations-powered image and text generation.

highlights.title: Gemini 2.0 Flash
highlights.text: Use `gemini` through the text API, with temperature and JSON-mode options. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini).

highlights.title: Gemini Flash Thinking
highlights.text: Use `gemini-thinking` for Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking through the text API. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini-thinking).
